title: Battle for Zendikar: card flavor text

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane overrun by the Eldrazi, whose land seems angry and in pain.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Vast beings hungering without limit that sweep across Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose brood ravages Zendikar and leaves only dust and memory.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan not seen in months; one of the monstrous trinity.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan, one of the monstrous trinity.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar ravaged by Ulamog's lineage.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: An ambush leader who fights the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ganda
entities.description: A Goma Fada deserter.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: A vampire, thrall of Ulamog, who returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads survivors of Sea Gate and rallies Zendikar's armies.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A city on Zendikar that suffered a massacre and later was retaken.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker elf whose connection to Zendikar is restored.

entities.name: General Tazri
entities.description: An allied commander of Zendikar's forces.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker demon who seeks revenge on Zendikar.

entities.name: Tars Olan
entities.description: A kor world-gift who sends a message by griffin.

entities.name: Stone Havens
entities.description: A refuge region whose scouts and mystics protect Zendikar's survivors.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people of Zendikar who fight the Eldrazi together.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A kor line-slinger.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker who counsels Jace and wanted the Eldrazi returned to stasis.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Creator of the hedrons.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Stones made by Nahiri that harm and bind the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Bruse Tarl
entities.description: A Goma Fada nomad.

entities.name: Yon Basrel
entities.description: An Oran-Rief survivalist.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who stole a bident from a god on another world.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: An expedition leader.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A god worshipped on Zendikar, in truth a twisted memory of Emrakul.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A Tazeem roilmage who turned from lullmage to rousing Zendikar's fury.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who advocated destroying the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Javad Nasrin
entities.description: An outrider captain.

entities.name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
entities.description: A vampire sage.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: A Kalastria bloodchief who refuses to live as a slave and frees vampires.

entities.name: Harak
entities.description: A Malakir bloodwitch.

entities.name: Raff Slugeater
entities.description: A goblin shortcutter.

entities.name: Jalun
entities.description: An Affa sentry.

entities.name: Nablus
entities.description: A North Hada trapper.

entities.name: Ryza
entities.description: An Oran-Rief scout.

entities.name: Najiya
entities.description: Leader of the Tajuru.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: Elves of Zendikar led by Najiya.

entities.name: Chadir the Navigator
entities.description: A navigator wary of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Greenweaver Mina
entities.description: A greenweaver who describes Zendikar's blighted lands.

entities.name: Zada
entities.description: A goblin who grinds hedrons.

entities.name: Aligned Hedron Network
entities.description: A hedron network that locks Ulamog in binding energy.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar beneath dense vegetation.

events.summary: Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage ravage the continent of Bala Ged.
events.quote: The continent of Bala Ged was ravaged by massive Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage

events.summary: Gideon arrives at Sea Gate too late to prevent the massacre but leads survivors to safety.
events.quote: Though Gideon arrived at Sea Gate too late to prevent the massacre, he still had enough time to lead its survivors to relative safety.

events.summary: Sea Gate falls and survivors flee.
events.quote: Sea Gate has fallen. Survivors are on the move.

events.summary: Gideon helps people escape from the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Suddenly, Gideon was there with us, clearing the way so that we could escape.

events.summary: A kor walks into the cavern and the Eldrazi part to admit him.
events.quote: The swirling mass of Eldrazi parted to admit him, then closed in his wake.

events.summary: Gideon learns from the kor the difference between working together and working as one.
events.quote: After watching the kor in battle, Gideon understood the difference between working together and working as one.

events.summary: Jace states he wanted to destroy the Eldrazi while Ugin wanted to return them to stasis.
events.quote: I said we should destroy the Eldrazi. Ugin wanted to return them to stasis.

events.summary: Ugin reminds Jace that the Eldrazi came as three.
events.quote: But do not forget: they came as three.

events.summary: Emeria's worshippers learn she was a twisted memory of Emrakul and abandon temples.
events.quote: When Emeria's worshippers learned that she was no more than a twisted memory of Emrakul, they abandoned their temples to the god.

events.summary: The merfolk gods are revealed to be false memories of the Eldrazi titans.
events.quote: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity

events.summary: Kiora steals a bident from a god on another world.
events.quote: Having gone to the trouble of stealing a bident from a god on another world, Kiora was eager to test its capabilities.

events.summary: Kalitas returns to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again.

events.summary: Everyone who could lift a weapon takes part in retaking Sea Gate.
events.quote: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

events.summary: Noyan Dar turns from lulling Zendikar to rousing its fury.
events.quote: After many years as a lullmage, Noyan Dar turned his talents from allaying Zendikar's fury to the considerably easier task of rousing it.

events.summary: The last hedron slots into place, locking Ulamog in an infinite loop of binding energy.
events.quote: The last hedron slotted into place, locking Ulamog in an infinite loop of binding energy.

events.summary: Nissa's connection to Zendikar is restored.
events.quote: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

events.summary: Emrakul has not been seen in months.
events.quote: Emrakul has not been seen in months.

events.summary: Goblins first see hedrons' potential against the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Goblins were first to see the potential of hedrons in the fight against the Eldrazi

events.summary: Drana declares she will not live as a slave and calls others to fight.
events.quote: I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me.

relations.note: Kalitas is a thrall of Ulamog.
Drana's vampires say never again to servitude under the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again.

relations.note: Ugin counsels Jace on the Eldrazi.

relations.quote: Even in the hands of amateurs, Nahiri's hedrons can harm the Eldrazi.
This fight is mine as much as it is yours.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis seeks revenge on Zendikar.
relations.quote: I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time.
